caller_requirements: Authenticate actual plan raw bytes and the exact reviewed metadata03 reference; frozen metadata document remains an ordinary selected logical input.
The caller provides bounded stable ordinary-route read callbacks and separately authenticates helper qualification.
Raw plan SHA is always the wire document SHA; full reconstructed plan drives existing typed guards and source associations.

capacity_model.note: Model uses a simple top-level reference representation, not this new exact envelope; its byte count is a feasibility estimate, not a prepared packet projection.

scope: Read complete helper and all12 controls; AST parsing only.
Reference bytes are SHA-checked before JSON parsing; duplicate/nonfinite JSON values fail closed.
Complete canonical typed JSON integrity covers the reconstructed full object; reference and remainder cannot overlap.
